contract: GRPCRoute rule and weighted backend RequestMirror with cross-namespace permission changes

nativeStreaming.scope: Native loopback with generated Amphora configuration, h2c primary and shadow, grpcio 1.83.0. No deployed Amphora, Gateway or Kubernetes traffic.

standard.cloudBoundary: Disposable kind Kubernetes and etcd, installed Octavia WSGI/SQL, Amphora driver renderer, native HAProxy and grpcio. Keystone, Neutron, Octavia RPC completion and Amphora agent transport are simulated.
standard.backendBoundary: Three live grpcio h2c origins behind Service and EndpointSlice resources. HAProxy uses the native private mirror socket transport with a fixture-local path and UID directives omitted for rootless execution. Each phase starts a new client after current Kubernetes and ACTIVE Octavia/native HAProxy convergence.
